notes.material: Ti base + Au-coating (DET-electrical ceiling, surface-only). The BASE alloy is deliberately NOT fixed here - it is a surface-only bracket, not an anchor candidate - but it is not free either: vendor DECLARES which Ti it used and to which spec, because a pinhole in the Au makes the base an exposed underlayer and the ICP-MS line below is read against that declaration
notes.process: SLM/DMLS Ti substrate + Au on the active face (DET-electrical ceiling; RFQ 1: surface-only, THIN Au): continuous, pinhole-free Au - electroplated hard gold over a Ni underlayer OR sputtered Au with its adhesion layer; vendor DECLARES the process and EVERY layer thickness (no thickness is fixed here: the pogo-pad 0.76 um is a contact-wear number, 02_02 1.2, not a DET one). Plating slot vs HIP / dehydrogenation bake is OPEN (00_07 HW.27) - do not sequence without written direction. NOT a structural alloy
notes.surface_finish: Au active face (best-case DET). EAAE dual-scale on the Ti base BEFORE plating (micro Sa 0.5-5 um + nano Sv 50-500 nm, 01_02 1.2) = HOLD POINT: SEM Sa/Sv on the etched Ti before plating (acceptance 0.5-5 um / 50-500 nm). SEM Sa/Sv again on the delivered Au face (report only, no target): the plating may fill the nano-scale, so the delivered face is not the etched one
notes.coating_restriction: As DELIVERED: bare Au on the active face - no dielectric overlayer: ZnO-Ta, self-healing 8-HQ and biomimetic (Zn-HAp/chitosan) FORBIDDEN on top of the Au (01_02 3.6 principle: an active face carries only conductive, ion-conductive or nothing; RFQ 4.B). The Gen 2.0 MET stack is applied downstream by us, after delivery (01_02 1.3 order)
notes.inspection: SEM magnifications for the two hold points named in surface_finish (01_02 1.5, factory obligation): x5,000 for micro-roughness Sa and x50,000 for nano-pores Sv - on the ETCHED Ti before plating the x50,000 frame is the acceptance one (no nano-pores visible = etch insufficient, repeat EAAE 01_02 1.3 Step 4); on the DELIVERED Au face both are report-only, because plating may fill the nano-scale. 01_02 1.5 also names x500 for gyroid macro-pores, which a flat coupon does not have. CV/EIS biochem (Stage-2, 01_01 6); j on PROJECTED area (01_02 1.4). Au = DET upper bound per unit TRUE area (in-silico 53, tunnelling only) - a planarised Au face can read BELOW the EAAE alloys on projected-area j, so report the roughness factor / double-layer capacitance alongside j. ICP-MS in synthetic sap: Au + every DECLARED underlayer element (Ni if plated over Ni; Cr/Ti if sputtered) - RFQ 3, every functionalised coupon; canon sets NO threshold for these - report the number, do not invent a pass/fail
extra: Bracket coupon: DET-electrical CEILING (Au = best electron transfer) — pair to the Ta biocompat ceiling; real alloys sit between
Surface-only control: cheap Ti substrate + thin Au; NOT an anchor candidate (Au not structural/biostable 20yr in xylem)
Tree-first down-select: CV/EIS + ion-release in synthetic xylem sap, not PBS (01_04 4.2)
